ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there is a circle with P as the center, and radii connect to B, Y, C, A, X. B, P, A are on the same straight line, so BA is a diameter; X, P, Y are also on the same straight line, so XY is a diameter. Along the semicircle from B to A, passing through Y and C, the three central angles are labeled in order as 3x°, (3x-3)°, (2x+15)°. Reasoning: Because BA is a diameter, the sum of the three central angles on the same semicircle is 180°. Therefore 3x+(3x-3)+(2x+15)=180, combining gives 8x+12=180, so 8x=168, x=21. Thus ∠BPY=3x=63°. Also because X and Y are the two endpoints of a diameter, PX and PY are opposite rays, so ∠BPX and ∠BPY are supplementary, ∠BPX=180°-63°=117°. The measure of arc BX is equal to the measure of the corresponding central angle ∠BPX, so m\widehat{BX}=117.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle centered at P with radii drawn to B, Y, C, A, and X. From the image, B-P-A is a straight line, so BA is a diameter, and X-P-Y is also a straight line, so XY is a diameter. The central angles along the semicircle from B to A through Y and C are labeled 3x°, (3x-3)°, and (2x+15)°. Use the diameter rule: angles forming a semicircle sum to 180°, so set 3x+(3x-3)+(2x+15)=180 and solve x=21. Then angle BPY is 3x=63°. Since X and Y are opposite endpoints of a diameter, angle BPX is supplementary to angle BPY, so angle BPX=180-63=117°. Finally, use the central-angle/arc-measure rule to conclude m arc BX = 117.

推理：因为 BA 是直径，所以同一半圆上的三个圆心角和为 180°。因此 3x+(3x-3)+(2x+15)=180，合并得 8x+12=180，所以 8x=168，x=21。于是 ∠BPY=3x=63°。又因为 X 和 Y 是直径的两个端点，PX 与 PY 是相反射线，所以 ∠BPX 与 ∠BPY 互补，∠BPX=180°-63°=117°。弧 BX 的度数等于对应圆心角 ∠BPX 的度数，所以 m\widehat{BX}=117。
